text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm suuuper happy I get to go
stargazing with
Ayabe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll go just about anywhere if it means
snapping
some cute pics. Whether it's up
in the mountains
or down by the beach!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a little chilly, but I'm just fine! You
know,
being super cute is kinda like
climbing a
mountain!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe, you're such a meanie! I was really
looking
forward to today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That bright cluster of stars is the
Andromeda
Galaxy. Can you see it looks
like an oval?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The name "Andromeda" comes from a
beautiful
princess in Greek mythology.
She was to be
sacrificed but was saved
by a hero in the end.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You're awfully quiet now. Could you
not stare
at me like that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why is your camera out?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The stars reflecting in your eyes looked
so cute.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
D-don't be stupid! Give me your phone
right now,
I'm deleting that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, pleeease! I promise I won't show
anyone,
so can't I keep it? ♪
